-- SELECT -- sp.id id, -- sp.wbs_code, -- IFNULL(parent.id,0) parent_id, -- sp.wbs_name title, -- sp.wbs_eng_name , -- sp.id AS 'value', -- sp.id AS 'key' -- FROM -- sp_wbs_info sp -- LEFT JOIN (SELECT id,wbs_code FROM sp_wbs_info WHERE is_deleted = 0) parent ON parent.wbs_code = sp.parent_wbs_code -- WHERE -- sp.is_deleted = 0 SELECT sp.ID ID, sp.wbs_code, COALESCE ( parent.ID, 0 ) parent_id, sp.TEXT title, sp.english_text, sp.objects_id, sp.element_id, sp.streams_id, obj."data" dataJson FROM sp_wbs_info sp LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ID, wbs_code FROM sp_wbs_info WHERE is_deleted = 0 ) parent ON parent.wbs_code = sp.parent_wbs_code LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ID, data FROM objects ) obj ON obj.ID = sp.objects_id WHERE sp.is_deleted = 0
AND sp.streams_id = #{streamsId}

SELECT sp.id id, sp.wbs_code, COALESCE (parent.id, 0 ) parent, sp."text" "text", sp.english_text, sp.duration, sp.progress, sp.start_date startDate, sp.deadline, sp.open, sp.info_type, sp.wbs_level, sp.element_id, sp.objects_id, sp.streams_id FROM sp_wbs_info sp LEFT JOIN ( SELECT id, wbs_code FROM sp_wbs_info WHERE is_deleted = 0 ) parent ON parent.wbs_code = sp.parent_wbs_code WHERE sp.is_deleted = 0
AND sp.streams_id = #{streamsId}

SELECT sp.ID ID, sp.wbs_code, COALESCE ( parent.ID, 0 ) parent, sp."text" "text", sp.duration, sp.start_date startDate, sp.deadline, sp.info_type, sp.wbs_level, sp.objects_id FROM sp_wbs_info sp LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ID, wbs_code FROM sp_wbs_info WHERE is_deleted = 0 ) parent ON parent.wbs_code = sp.parent_wbs_code WHERE sp.is_deleted = 0
AND sp.streams_id = #{streamsId}

SELECT obj."id" AS obj_id, obj."streamId" AS obj_stream_id, obj."data" ->> 'type' AS obj_type, obj."data" ->> 'units' AS obj_units, obj."data" ->> 'family' AS obj_family, obj."data" ->> 'category' AS obj_category, obj."data" ->> 'elementId' AS obj_elementId FROM objects obj WHERE obj."id" = #{objId} LIMIT 1;

SELECT newCompriseData.* FROM ( SELECT compriseData.* FROM (-- category SELECT DISTINCT obj."data" ->> 'category' AS label, obj."data" ->> 'category' AS ID, obj."data" ->> 'category' AS "parentId", 'category' AS "level" FROM objects obj WHERE obj."streamId" = #{streamsId} AND obj."data" ->> 'category' is not null AND obj."data" ->> 'family' is not null AND obj."data" ->> 'type' is not null UNION ALL-- family SELECT DISTINCT obj."data" ->> 'family' AS label, obj."data" ->> 'family' AS ID, obj."data" ->> 'category' AS "parentId", 'family' AS "level" FROM objects obj WHERE obj."streamId" = #{streamsId} AND obj."data" ->> 'category' is not null AND obj."data" ->> 'family' is not null UNION ALL-- type SELECT DISTINCT obj."data" ->> 'type' AS label, obj."data" ->> 'type' AS ID, obj."data" ->> 'family' AS "parentId", 'type' AS "level" FROM objects obj WHERE obj."streamId" = #{streamsId} AND obj."data" ->> 'family' is not null AND obj."data" ->> 'type' is not null -- elementId UNION ALL SELECT obj."data" ->> 'elementId' AS label, obj."data" ->> 'elementId' AS ID, obj."data" ->> 'type' AS "parentId", 'elementId' AS "level" FROM objects obj WHERE obj."streamId" = #{streamsId} AND obj."data" ->> 'elementId' is not null AND obj."data" ->> 'type' is not null ) AS compriseData ) newCompriseData
